description: Defines a template class SizedMRUCache for a size-limited, least-recently-used cache of untyped data blobs, including methods for insertion, retrieval, resizing, and cache management.

classes.name: SizedMRUCache
classes.description: A size-limited, least-recently-used cache storing blobs of untyped data.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Inserts a key-value pair with size into the cache, evicting if necessary.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value by key if it exists.

methods.name: getAt
methods.description: Retrieves a key and value at a specific index.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the cache is empty.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the current total size of stored data.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the cache, clearing existing data.

methods.name: shrinkToSize
methods.description: Reduces cache size to a specified limit by removing least recently used items.

methods.name: maxSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum total size allowed.
